title: Pennsylvania's 1st Congressional District general election, 2026
description: The general election for Pennsylvania's 1st Congressional District pits incumbent Republican Rep. Brian Fitzpatrick against Democratic challenger Bob Harvie, a Bucks County Commissioner. The district covers all of Bucks County and parts of Montgomery County in the Philadelphia suburbs, a purple area that has been competitive in recent cycles. Fitzpatrick, a moderate who chairs the bipartisan Problem Solvers Caucus and is often ranked the most bipartisan House member, is seeking his sixth full term. Harvie, who flipped the Bucks County Commission to Democratic control in 2019, is running on kitchen-table economic issues and criticizing Fitzpatrick's support for Trump-era policies, in a race viewed as one of Democrats' top pickup opportunities nationally.
polling_note: Polls cited are from the Harvie campaign's internal polling. No independent public polls were found for this race as of mid-2026. The Cook Political Report rates this seat as 'Likely Republican.'

candidates.name: Brian Fitzpatrick
candidates.summary: Brian Fitzpatrick is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Pennsylvania's 1st Congressional District, first elected in 2016. A former FBI Special Agent and federal prosecutor, he has been ranked the most bipartisan member of Congress for five consecutive years by the Lugar Center and serves as elected chairman of the bipartisan Problem Solvers Caucus. Fitzpatrick sits on the House Ways and Means Committee and the House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence, where he chairs the CIA subcommittee.

career_history.title: United States Representative
career_history.description: Representing Pennsylvania's 8th district (2017-2018) and 1st district (2019-present). Serves on Ways and Means Committee and House Intelligence Committee. Chairman of the bipartisan Problem Solvers Caucus.

career_history.title: FBI Supervisory Special Agent
career_history.description: Served as National Director for FBI's Campaign Finance and Election Crimes Enforcement Program and as a national supervisor for the Political Corruption Unit. Served in Operation Iraqi Freedom. Won FBI Director's Award and named Investigator of the Year.

career_history.title: Special Assistant United States Attorney
career_history.description: Prosecuted violent drug and gun offenders.

education.institution: Penn State University / Dickinson School of Law

candidates.name: Bob Harvie
candidates.summary: Bob Harvie is a Bucks County Commissioner and the Democratic nominee for Pennsylvania's 1st Congressional District. A lifelong Bucks County resident and former high school social studies teacher of 26 years, Harvie was first elected county commissioner in 2019, helping flip the board to Democratic control for the first time in nearly four decades. He has emphasized affordability, bipartisanship, and his record of countywide electoral success in a politically competitive district as he challenges incumbent Brian Fitzpatrick.

career_history.title: Bucks County Commissioner / Board Vice-Chair
career_history.description: Elected in November 2019, sworn in January 2020. Served as Chair in 2022 and 2025, Vice-Chair in 2024 and 2026. Re-elected to a second term in November 2023. Chairs the Board of Elections, Retirement Board, and Board to Select Depositories.

career_history.title: Social Studies Teacher and Department Chair
career_history.description: Taught for 26 years, including 20 years at BCTHS where he served as chairman of the Social Studies Department. Created the 'Beyond the Books' veterans program.

career_history.title: Chairman of the Board of Supervisors
career_history.description: Served as chairman longer than anyone in Falls Township history. Previously served on the Falls Township Planning Commission for two years and was elected to the Board of Supervisors in 2003.
